import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static String[] a = new String[30];
    static String[] b = new String[30];
    static int[][] dist1 = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] dist2 = new int[30][30];
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int source, sink;
    static int[] di = new int[100000];
    static int[] ptr = new int[100000];
    static int[] q = new int[100000];
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] g = new List[100000];

    static int whereX, whereY;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void add(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge();
        e1.a = a;
        e1.b = b;
        e1.cap = cap;
        e1.flow = 0;
        Edge e2 = new Edge();
        e2.a = b;
        e2.b = a;
        e2.cap = 0;
        e2.flow = 0;
        g[a].add(e.size());
        e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size());
        e.add(e2);
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return (x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n);
    }

    static void BFS1(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new Pair(x, y));
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 20; j++) {
                dist1[i][j] = 1000000000;
            }
        }
        dist1[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair pair = q.poll();
            int x1 = pair.first;
            int y1 = pair.second;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x2 = x1 + dx[i];
                int y2 = y1 + dy[i];
                if (ok(x2, y2) && dist1[x2][y2] >= 1000000000 && b[x2].charAt(y2) != 'Y') {
                    dist1[x2][y2] = dist1[x1][y1] + 1;
                    q.add(new Pair(x2, y2));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(di, -1);
        int qh = 0;
        int qt = 0;
        q[qt++] = source;
        di[source] = 0;
        while (qh < qt && di[sink] == -1) {
            int v = q[qh++];
            for (int pt = 0; pt < g[v].size(); pt++) {
                int id = g[v].get(pt);
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (di[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q[qt++] = to;
                    di[to] = di[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return di[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        for (int i = 0; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
            int id = g[v].get(i);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (di[to] != di[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed != 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (!bfs()) break;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (int pushed = dfs(source, 1000000000)) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static void BFS2(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new Pair(x, y));
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 20; j++) {
                dist2[i][j] = 1000000000;
            }
        }
        dist2[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair pair = q.poll();
            int x1 = pair.first;
            int y1 = pair.second;
            if (dist2[x1][y1] >= dist1[x1][y1]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x2 = x1 + dx[i];
                int y2 = y1 + dy[i];
                if (ok(x2, y2) && dist2[x2][y2] >= 1000000000 && a[x2].charAt(y2) != 'Y' && dist2[x1][y1] + 1 <= dist1[x2][y2]) {
                    dist2[x2][y2] = dist2[x1][y1] + 1;
                    q.add(new Pair(x2, y2));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        t = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    b[i] = b[i].substring(0, j) + "Y" + b[i].substring(j + 1);
                    a[i] = a[i].substring(0, j) + "Y" + a[i].substring(j + 1);
                    whereX = i;
                    whereY = j;
                }
            }
        }
        BFS1();
        source = 0;
        sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int what = i * n + j + 1;
                int what2 = n * n + i * n + j + 1;
                add(source, what, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                add(what2, sink, b[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                BFS2(i, j);
                for (int ptx = 0; ptx < n; ptx++) {
                    for (int pty = 0; pty < n; pty++) {
                        if (b[ptx].charAt(pty) == 'Y' || dist2[ptx][pty] > t) continue;
                        add(what, n * n + ptx * n + pty + 1, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        n = 2 * n * n + 5;
        pw.println(max_flow());
        pw.close();
    }
}
